$comment: How `studio anchor candidates` and `studio anchor build` draw this channel's anchors (studio/README.md, 'Anchors'). The character rules are channels/8bitnews-us/format.md, 'Ведущие'. Every anchor of the channel shares `canvas`, so any template can place any anchor.
prompt: Generate one image. NES 8-bit pixel art character sprite, bold black outlines, flat colors, limited NES palette, no gradients, no anti-aliasing. An adult TV news anchor: {who}, wearing {outfit}. Front view, facing the viewer, head and upper torso only, cut off at mid-chest by the bottom edge of the image, arms down at the sides. Calm, neutral, professional expression, eyes open looking at the viewer, mouth closed. Adult proportions: realistic head-to-body ratio, normal-size eyes; not chibi, not anime, not a mascot, not a cartoon caricature. An original character who does not resemble any real person. The figure is centered and fills most of the frame height, with a small margin above the head. Background: one completely flat solid pure green color (#00FF00), no desk, no studio, no shadows, no other objects. No text, no letters, no logos, no badges, no flags, no microphones, no earpieces.
